no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw Tailwind palette class is not allowed. Use a semantic token (bg-surface, text-muted-foreground, border-border, text-warning, bg-primary...). Tokens are defined in config/theme.config.ts.
Raw Tailwind palette class is not allowed inside a template string. Use a semantic token from config/theme.config.ts.
Hard-coded hex colour. Colours belong in config/theme.config.ts only.
Hard-coded hex colour in a template string. Colours belong in config/theme.config.ts only.
Hard-coded colour function. Use hsl(var(--token)) or a Tailwind semantic class.

patterns.message: Never import a data adapter directly. Import from '@/lib/data' so the fixture adapter can be swapped for Prisma without touching screens.
Presenters must not fetch data. Receive data and callbacks as props from the container page (see docs/02-ARCHITECTURE.md). Type-only imports are allowed: use 'import type'.
